findings.title: Refund rule contradicts the recorded cancellation policy
findings.why: specs/001-rental-module/spec.md records the policy as no refund under 24 h before start, otherwise full. `refundAmount` instead gives a 50% refund under 24 h before start (line 108). Spec 005 says no answer was available and assumes the 50% rule, even though the policy was already written down. A customer cancelling 10 hours ahead gets half back when the recorded policy says nothing.

findings.title: Bookings are accepted outside the school's April–October season
findings.why: README says the school runs from April to October. `book`, `quote` and `availability` accept any date, such as a January rental. Spec 001 says the season rule is not stated for rentals, so this is an assumption. It could be wrong, and it is unconfirmed.

findings.title: Spec 001 is stale after specs 003–005
findings.why: FR-007 says cancellation is not implemented, and the edge case 'not at midnight → error' no longer holds for hourly periods. FR-003 says total = days × daily price, which is wrong for stays of 3 or more days with the discount. Specs 003–005 changed these rules without updating spec 001.

findings.title: FR-004 says any UTC instant but the code requires the hour
findings.why: FR-004 says `at` is an ISO-8601 UTC instant. The clarification and `parseOnTheHourUtc` in src/index.ts reject times like 10:30. A cancellation at 10:30 throws, which the FR text does not suggest.
